corrected.reason: double_rated and alpha were computed over pairs with >=2 judgment rows rather than >=2 distinct annotators, so an annotator re-judging a pair counted as two independent opinions

recomputed.note: alpha is set to null above rather than 0.968 deliberately: at 13 units the confidence interval spans essentially the whole admissible range, so no agreement estimate is defensible for this release. The recomputed value is recorded here for traceability, not for quotation.

corrected.release_trigger_effect: the +150 double-rated trigger now fires at 163 rather than 185, i.e. earlier than the erroneous baseline would have
